title: Period and Shifted Graph of y = cos(x + 2*pi/3) - 2
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the fundamental period of y = \cos(x + 2\pi/3) - 2 and describe the transformations and key coordinates of its graph.

steps.title: Determine the Fundamental Period
steps.explanation: The coefficient of x is 1, so the fundamental period of the cosine wave is 2*pi.
steps.why: Translations in x and y preserve the wavelength of a periodic function.

steps.title: Identify Shifts, Midline, and Range
steps.explanation: The standard cosine graph is shifted 2*pi/3 units to the left and 2 units downward, oscillating around the midline y = -2 between -3 and -1.
steps.why: Adding 2*pi/3 to x shifts left by 2*pi/3, and subtracting 2 shifts all y-values down by 2.

steps.title: Identify Key Landmarks Over One Cycle [-2*pi/3, 4*pi/3]
steps.explanation: Subtract 2*pi/3 from the standard cosine x-landmarks 0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi and subtract 2 from their y-values 1, 0, -1, 0, 1.
steps.why: Coordinate-wise transformation (x, y) -> (x - 2*pi/3, y - 2) gives the exact cycle endpoints and extrema.
